availability: Entry panel at signal close; causal path only at survived close; final/forward labels in separate files; no imputation
confirmation: ALL CURRENT HISTORY HAS ALREADY BEEN TOUCHED BY PREVIOUS RESEARCH. No untouched OOS or confirmatory data.
discovery: signal and closed exit before holdout; crossing/censored trades excluded from selection
execution: Long only, next open entries/market exits, survived-close stop updates effective next bar, stops before current high, gap at open, trend priority; no costs/sizing/portfolio

finite_plan.combination: Only independently discovery-screened families; highest discovery expectancy then id in each family; at most one entry+exit per module
finite_plan.early_failure: No new early-failure family without a previously replicated decision-time pattern; descriptive failures alone are insufficient
finite_plan.lifecycle: Require >=20 discovery material-giveback losers and >=20 winners. Activation is smallest of 1/2/3/4% >= median loser known MFE, capped at 4%. Winner-path q75 material giveback rounded up to .50/.65/.80 (cap .80); stall q75 rounded up to 3/5/10 (cap 10). Three families: close giveback, stalled giveback, 10% running-MFE lock after stall. Quantiles use winners after the selected activation level.
finite_plan.rejection: Only WR V1 previously frozen Entry V1 regions; >=30 discovery trades inside and outside, negative inside expectancy, lower WR/PF/MFE or worse MAE, >=60% lower-expectancy agreement across >=5 symbols and >=2 years with >=5 trades/arm. At most one by lowest inside expectancy, then id.
finite_plan.relaxation: Only replicated bo_long_fail_price strict sole blocker; all other independent gates pass, no other active modules. Original mask/score remain unchanged; synthetic signal is explicitly experimental.
finite_plan.selection: Only stage 1-5 IN-SAMPLE rows; no post-replay threshold edits

holdout: signal >= boundary; full historical indicator warm-up retained
peak_timing: Existing zero-based bars_to_mfe retained; new peak_age_exact is one-based; uncertainty remains NA

screen.agreement: >=60% WR and expectancy nondecrease in >=10 symbols and >=3 years, >=5 trades/arm/group
screen.large_winner_truncation: <=10% of matched >=10% winners lose >25% of return
screen.losers: count <= baseline; mean and median loss no larger
screen.tail: expectancy after removing top5 positive trades > max(0, baseline same exclusion)
screen.winners: count >= baseline; mean and median >=90% baseline

statistical_limits: Correlated/overlapping trades, reused historical universe, multiple comparisons, no causal identification, no significance or TradingView parity
